text.tspan: Cardiovascular death rate: crude versus age-standardizedUnited States
The reported annual death rate from cardiovascular diseases per 100,000 people, based on the underlying cause
listed on death certificates. This is compared between age-standardized death rates and crude death rates.
Note: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized. All deaths in a country may not have been
registered with a cause of death.
